official.name: Romanian
official.family: Romance — derived from Latin, an exception surrounded by Slavic-speaking countries

terrainDescription.zh: 喀爾巴阡山脈環繞，多瑙河沿岸平原
terrainDescription.en: Ringed by the Carpathian mountains, with plains along the Danube

plate.color: white background, black text, format CC 12 ABC (2-letter county code)
plate.shape: rectangular; 520×110mm mandatory on front, narrower 340×200mm variant sometimes used on the rear of SUV-type vehicles

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Bollards are rarely used at all in Romania — not a reliable clue

utilityPole.transformerMount: "Holey poles" like Hungary's (holes reach the ground), often with a white-painted base and/or yellow marking near the bottom

historicalContext.zh: 源自古羅馬「達契亞」行省歷史，語言承襲拉丁語根源，因此和西班牙語/義大利語有一定程度可辨認的相似字彙。
historicalContext.en: Traces its roots to the Roman province of Dacia; the Latin-derived vocabulary gives it recognizable overlap with Spanish/Italian.
